Grants the following for #e${7+#d} seconds upon readying the weapon within 5? seconds of scoring a Kill with a different weapon:
• 25% decreased ADS Animation Duration
• 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of <primary/>Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for <special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons. (Scoring multiple kills with a single shot/burst still only refunds 1 ammo.)
